# Deny all matched pending Venmo payment requests from friend/roommate senders.
# (Re-auth to ensure token is valid)

venmo_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_email = 'connorbrow@gmail.com'
venmo_access_token = apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_email, password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

matched_ids = [956, 1846, 5568, 1843, 304, 5567, 4152, 6034, 6037, 5565, 5566, 953, 4155, 1844]
print('denying_count', len(matched_ids))

results = []
for pid in matched_ids:
    resp = apis.venmo.deny_payment_request(payment_request_id=pid, access_token=venmo_access_token)
    results.append((pid, resp))
    print('denied', pid, 'resp', resp)

print('done', len(results))
